description: Obsidian vault layout for the LEAP long-term knowledge layer. The MCP server only returns this specification; the host agent writes the actual files.
role: complete canonical human knowledge source, more detailed than HTML
not_a_state_store: The LEAP runtime remains the authoritative structured state source. These Markdown files are a human-facing workspace and must not be treated as a strongly consistent database.

directories.purpose: Knowledge structure mirrored from the DAG

linking_rules: Use resolvable vault-root [[wikilinks]]; add reciprocal links on target notes or their real backlink indexes.
Connect prerequisites, successor concepts, misconceptions, worked examples, exercises and source notes.
State is a timestamped Runtime snapshot, never local evidence authority.
Markdown contains all projected teaching prose plus extended derivations, assumptions, comparisons and extra cases.
No verified video: insert topic-specific core/extension/advanced search queries at the top.

# <specific skill>

> [!info] Learning resources
> Verified video records only after accessibility and topical content checks.
> Otherwise core: <topic + operation + beginner>; extension: <conditions + comparison>; advanced: <proof + transfer>.

Related: [[01_Knowledge/Knowledge_Map]] · [[01_Knowledge/Nodes/<prerequisite>]]

## Prerequisite refresher and symbol glossary

Explain every prerequisite operation and check it with a short example.

## Principle, assumptions and mechanism

State precisely what is true, when it is true, and why it works.

## Labeled diagram and controllable walkthrough

Choose a faithful structure/cutaway, causal/state trace, data plot or comparison view.
Explain every part name, quantity, unit and model limit. Link a controllable HTML view
to a static SVG/storyboard or table; retain the complete explanation in this note.
For new visual deliveries declare visual_contract (anatomy.v1), with real selectors,
captions, labels, static_frame and shared model_binding for animated figures.

## Complete worked example

1. State exact inputs, units and domain constraints.
2. Show each operation and its reason, preserving intermediate results.
3. Check the final result independently and against boundary cases.

## Misconceptions, boundaries and contrasting cases

Show an incorrect method, explain the failure, repair it, and compare a valid nearby case.

## Graduated practice and full solutions

Basic, variation and challenge tasks each include conditions, full derivation and error analysis.

## Transfer and delayed review

Change parameters or context. Require a fresh learner answer; answer reveal is not evidence of mastery.

> [!example]- Extended derivation beyond the HTML projection
> Include additional original reasoning, annotated steps, alternate methods, counterexamples and extra practice here.

## Sources, limitations and projection coverage

Record actual source URL, locator, excerpt, date and checks; do not imply syllabus alignment from general sources.
Map each HTML teaching section to a full note section. Register both bodies through save_teaching_package.

learning_resources.placement: At the top of each teaching document, before lesson content
learning_resources.prefer: Precisely relevant videos only after verifying URL accessibility, title/publisher, actual topical content and a useful timestamp or section.
learning_resources.unverified_video_rule: Omit the video completely; no guessed title, invented URL or availability guarantee.
learning_resources.fallback: Use precise topic + skill/operation + level search terms, with separate core/extension/advanced suggestions; label them as queries rather than sources read.
learning_resources.no_future_guarantee: Verification describes the checked moment only; every later generation rechecks or falls back to keywords.

markdown_requirements.states: Learner state in Markdown is explicitly a Runtime snapshot, never authoritative local mastery.
markdown_requirements.coverage: Compare visible teaching prose and formulas, not HTML/CSS/JS character count. Keep all projected content plus additional original explanation and examples in Markdown.

visualization.priority: visual first where a picture reveals structure, mechanism or state
visualization.no_visual_exception: Record an explicit pedagogical reason for a nonvisualizable point, not a blanket omission.
visualization.truth_boundary: Graphs and sampled simulations illustrate; analytical reasoning or full checks establish conclusions.
authoring_rules: Make structure, mechanism and change visible. Use a recognizable object or experiment when it maps faithfully to the subject; use a state trace or spatial model when a physical metaphor would mislead.

Choose complementary views by teaching purpose: cutaway/exploded structure for parts, cause-and-effect or state transitions for mechanism, labeled data plots for quantities, and contrasting cases for model limits. Do not impose a decorative image count.
Build deliberate, shaded parts in correct depth order. Put explanations and part names in a linked legend; reserve color for the currently relevant subject or a consistent data meaning.
Use one explicit model for moving parts, charts and live readouts. Explain units, normalized geometry, assumptions and limits; never animate a visual independently of the quantity it claims to show.

Offer play/pause, reset and reversible steps or scrubbing. Start still; pause offscreen or in a hidden tab, and offer discrete states under reduced motion. Do not announce each animation frame to screen readers.
Supply a real inline SVG, image or table as a static storyboard with conditions and complete explanations in canonical Markdown; a promise of a fallback is insufficient.

Declare visual_contract with profile anatomy.v1 in new or revised visual deliveries. Preserve older manifests; the Runtime checks records and targets while browser scenarios and host review check behavior and truth.

contract.model_binding: source describes the shared model; quantities lists name, unit and a real output selector. These declarations are not evaluated as code.
contract.controls: play_pause and reset plus either step_forward/step_back or scrub/parameter; all targets are actual enabled buttons, inputs or selects.
contract.states: At least two explained states, also recorded in canonical Markdown.
contract.selectors: Unique #id targets; static_frame points to an actual SVG, image or table. Captions and labels occur in both delivered bodies.
contract.compatibility: Optional for existing packages; required by the authoring workflow for newly generated or revised visual packages.

review: check release/intermediate/end states against independent calculations
exercise every control with pointer and keyboard
check pause, reset, reduced motion, offscreen and hidden-tab behavior
read the static storyboard with JavaScript disabled
